title: Fizz Jar
about: FIZZ JAR: a falling-pair puzzle for an 8-bit handheld. Pairs of fizzy drops fall into a soda jar; line up four of a colour with the grumpy sours to pop them, and pop every sour to clear the jar. Written in Sprout.
line: An 8-bit falling-pair puzzle: drop fizzy pairs into a soda jar and pop the grumpy sours four of a colour at a time; chains score double.
